v.title: Kane’s Midfield Mastery: 73 Goals From the Backline
v.excerpt: Kane’s 73 goals came from a midfield‑style drop‑deep play, redefining the striker role and hinting at tactical shifts for Barcelona and the Premier League.
v.body:
## Quick take
Harry Kane’s 73‑goal haul last season came from a role that feels more like a midfield play‑maker than a traditional striker. He drops deep, threads passes, and still finishes with a record‑breaking tally.

## What happened
BBC Sport’s exclusive interview shows Kane admitting that his success stems from a “positioning game” that mimics a midfield pivot. He explained how he uses space, timing, and his left foot to create chances for teammates while still finding the net himself. The interview also revealed that he trains with a midfield mindset, focusing on vision and passing rather than just finishing.

The conversation highlights how Kane’s approach blurs the line between striker and midfielder. He talked about how his drop‑deep runs open up the defensive line, allowing him to be in the right place to finish off plays. He also noted that this style keeps defenders guessing and creates more goal‑scoring opportunities for the whole team.

## Why it matters
- **Barcelona’s tactical evolution**: If Barça can adopt a similar “dropping deep” strategy, it would free up players like Pedri and Gavi to roam, creating more fluid attacks and reducing reliance on a single target man.
- **Kane’s legacy**: Kane’s success from midfield positions redefines the modern striker role, suggesting that the next generation of forwards should prioritize versatility and play‑making over pure goal‑scoring.
- **Premier League’s competitive edge**: Chelsea and Tottenham will need to adapt their defensive setups to counter a Kane who can both finish and dictate play, forcing them to rethink their defensive midfield pairing.

## What’s next
Watch how Kane’s drop‑deep runs influence Tottenham’s game plan in the next match. Will he continue to dominate from the midfield or will he revert to a more traditional striker role? The key moment will be whether he can maintain his 73‑goal rhythm while also feeding teammates, a balance that could dictate the Premier League’s attacking trends for the rest of the season.

*Source: [73 goals from dropping deep - we ask Kane to break down how he did it](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/articles/cx2z7rjn2p2o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)*
